_note: Label presets: each has label_style (see label_style.py), label_offset (leader look, see label_offset.py) and declutter (tiers, scale visibility, scoring, legend; see label_declutter.py). Used by render_world.py --label-preset NAME and by the panel's Labels tab (Apply preset). Edit freely; keys left out keep the current / default value.

legacy._title: Legacy (before declutter): black thin leaders, first-fit placement, nothing hidden

working._title: Town working map: every tier for the scale, white leaders with casing, hidden labels kept in a hidden sublayer

bowl._title: Declutter: bowl overview - districts, plazas and civic buildings only, larger text, rest hidden

clean._title: Clean map: quiet dotted leaders, smaller text, fewer tiers

handout._title: Player handout: civic buildings as numbered markers with a legend key in the margin
